lines.52: 「Princess... what are your plans for summer vacation?」
lines.53: 「I'll be fairly busy. But that doesn't mean I can't make time to see you.」
lines.55: 「Yawn... Well, shall we get some sleep?」
lines.56: 「Princess, you really can fall asleep in front of me.」
lines.64: 「No, sorry for disturbing you when you're tired.」
lines.67: I was sleeping in the same bed as the Princess.
lines.70: Boy, does she fall asleep fast!
lines.72: I gazed at her peaceful sleeping face.
lines.73: When she's quiet, she's a true Sleeping Beauty.
lines.74: I hoped with all my heart that we could keep going like this.
